name: MyMood
tagline: Simple and minimalistic app to track your daily mood with.
blurb: MyMood is a minimalistic and simple app that gives you an empty mood page per day to fill it.
description:
MyMood is a minimalistic and simple app that gives you an empty mood page per day to fill it.
You can add events that effected your mood today, see all the events by their effect and keep track of the day you added.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
